title: Task poll request
description: POST /api/v1/tasks/poll (FR-3.2, P3-S03). Asks for the host's next task. The agent polls at its configured interval and promptly after a heartbeat that carries the tasks_available directive, and only when it has no task in flight. The host is the credential's host, never a field in the body.

schema_version.description: Payload schema version. This directory is version 1.
